narrative: Four levers explain most of HTB's earnings and capital risk: Bank Rate (about £12M of NII per 100 bps in the first year), lending growth (about £0.9M of income per point in-year), cost of risk (about £5M per 10 bps on a £5Bn book) and the cost-income ratio (about £1.9M of cost per point). The same drivers feed NII, impairment, PBT and CET1.

signals.title: NIM compression: NII £1.1M behind budget in September
signals.excerpt: Variable lending and BoE reserves repriced after the 2026 Bank Rate cuts; £2.35Bn of fixed-term bonds reprice only on maturity. NIM 3.80% YTD vs 3.99% budget.

signals.title: Development finance stage 2 up from 9.8% to 16.4%
signals.excerpt: Four South East & East schemes (£52M) moved to stage 2 in Q3; FY2026 cost of risk forecast 30 bps vs 15 bps plan.
